decisions.reason: Community term common.stat.speed requires the literal accepted term 'Speed' for 速度 (forbidden 'Tốc độ' is present, no accepted form present), which would normally be a confident revise. However open canonical finding cf-9d903a48b310ef86 (match_mode=contains on 速度, no key exclusion) mechanically blocks this item too, even though that finding's actual concern is 跳过速度 ('skip speed') being misread as the Speed stat, not the bare exact stat label used here. Defer until canonical maintenance narrows cf-9d903a48b310ef86 (e.g. to exclude exact source_text=='速度' or restrict to sources containing 跳过) so the pure Common0072 stat label can resolve to 'Speed'.

canonical_finding.concept: Bare/exact 速度 stat label (Common0072) should resolve to Speed independently of the existing 跳过速度 skip-speed guard
canonical_finding.reason: cf-9d903a48b310ef86 uses match_mode=contains with no exclusion, so it also blocks the literal exact stat label it was never meant to cover; needs its own narrow exact-match resolution or an exclusion on the existing finding.
